title: Function Health biomarker grid
description: A serif heading, a small expert quote with a round avatar, then a hairline-divided grid of test categories (big light serif name, terracotta tube-icon count, a list of tests fading out at the end) with a cream 'more' tile as the last cell. Under it a rule and a 'take your results anywhere' row: serif line on the left, a hub tile and four soft destination tiles on the right.
notes: 3 columns on desktop, 2 on phones; the last list item of each cell fades out
the hub tile and avatar are media slots
name: functionhealth-biomarkers
